The feature is called "Auto-Tagging" and it's designed to automatically tag new items with relevant metadata, such as tags, keywords, and descriptions, when they are added to a collection or uploaded to a repository.

This feature is particularly useful for users who are not experts in metadata management, but still want to be able to easily find and manage their items. It's also useful for users who want to share their items with others, but don't want to manually add tags and descriptions.

The auto-tagging feature will be based on a user-defined set of tags, which will be used to identify the type of item being tagged. This will allow users to quickly and easily find specific items in their collection or repository.

The feature will also include a tag editor, which will allow users to manually add tags and descriptions to their items. This will provide users with more flexibility and control over their metadata.

The auto-tagging feature will be based on a machine learning algorithm, which will learn to identify patterns in the metadata and automatically tag new items. This will allow the algorithm to improve over time, and adapt to the changing needs of the users.

Overall, the Auto-Tagging feature is designed to make it easier for users to find and manage their items, while also providing a more flexible and user-friendly experience.

* Search for specific products using keywords and filters
* View product details, including product images, reviews, and ratings

* Have the ability to save and manage my preferences for future product recommendations
